h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bihar Sharif

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Bihar Sharif

c: Bihar Sharif is the headquarters of Nalanda district, a short drive from the ruins of ancient Nalanda and the hills of Rajgir. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment in Bihar Sharif to schools, colleges, district and block offices, municipal parks and private colonies. Our machines are made at our factory in Vasai, about 1,450 km away, and sent to Bihar by road.

Many buyers here are school managements or colony committees with a modest budget who want to start small. That works well with outdoor gym equipment, because each machine stands on its own footing and new ones can be added beside it later. Tell us how much you want to spend this year and we will suggest the three or four machines that cover the most users. The plains here have hot summers and a heavy monsoon, so we build with galvanised frames and roto-moulded parts.

richText.heading: Getting the most from a small first order

items.q: Can we start with only three outdoor gym machines?
items.a: Yes. Three machines are a sensible start for a school or colony. We draw the full layout at the beginning, so later machines fit into the space you have kept for them.

items.q: Do you deliver to Nalanda district?
items.a: Yes. We dispatch from our Vasai factory by road. Installation is done by our own team or a dealer covering eastern India.

items.q: How do we ask for a quote?
items.a: Email sales@funplaysystems.com or call +91 902 830 2266 with the size of the area, a few photos and your budget for this year. We will reply with suggested machines and a layout.
